name: Retries
definition: Trying a failed call again, in the hope it works the next time.

name: Transient errors
definition: Failures that pass on their own, so trying again can work.

name: Idempotence
definition: Doing something twice has the same effect as doing it once.

name: Circuit breakers
definition: Stopping calls to a service that keeps failing, for a while.

name: Timeouts
definition: Giving up on a call that takes too long, so the caller can move on.

name: Exponential growth
definition: Growth by the same multiple each step.

name: Arithmetic
definition: Adding, subtracting, multiplying and dividing numbers.

name: State
definition: What a system remembers from one moment to the next.

name: Function
definition: A rule that gives one output for each input.

name: Two-phase commit
definition: Asking every party first, then telling all of them to make a change.

name: Atomicity
definition: A change that happens whole, or not at all.

name: Partial failure
definition: Part of a system failing while the rest goes on.

name: Accounting equation
definition: Assets equal liabilities plus equity, always.

name: Exponential backoff
definition: Waiting longer after each failure, each wait a multiple of the last.

name: Network congestion
definition: A service or link given more load than it can carry.

name: Jitter
definition: A random amount taken from a wait, so many clients don't act at the same moment.

name: Idempotency keys
definition: A key sent with a request, so the same request sent twice is carried out once.

name: Unique keys
definition: A rule that no two rows of a table may share a value.

name: Identifier
definition: A name or number that picks out one thing.

name: Authorisation holds
definition: Holding money for a payment first, and taking it only once the payment is settled.

name: Double-entry bookkeeping
definition: Recording every movement of money twice: once as it leaves an account, once as it arrives.

name: Time and clocks
definition: Measuring time, and agreeing on it across machines.

name: Database transactions
definition: A group of changes to a database made together, or not at all.

name: Advisory locks
definition: A lock a program names and the database keeps, meaning whatever the program says.

name: HMAC
definition: A code made from a message and a shared secret, proving who sent it and that it wasn't changed.

name: Hash function
definition: A function from any data to a short, fixed-size value.

name: Secret
definition: Something only those meant to know it know.

name: Constant-time comparison
definition: Comparing secrets in a way that takes the same time whatever they hold.

name: Mutual exclusion
definition: Only one thing at a time in the part that touches a shared resource.

name: Concurrency
definition: Several things running at the same time.

name: Randomness
definition: Having no pattern anyone can use to predict it.

name: Bandwidth
definition: How much a link can carry in a given time.

name: Timing attacks
definition: Learning a secret from how long a system takes to answer.

name: Thundering herd problem
definition: Many waiting processes woken at once for something only one can have.

name: Rate limiting
definition: A service refusing requests beyond a set rate.
